delivery: Local, uncommitted, unpublished; no live user records accessed
fixes: Known compiled-schema column additions migrate while original values, IDs, relationships and assets remain verified
Migration and iCloud-restoration journals survive validated app-container relocation, including old journals and interrupted phases
Duplicate UUIDs no longer trap launch reconciliation; run navigation resolves exact stored records and ambiguous Coach actions reject before mutation
Home and Settings expose pending, offline, account, import and repair status without claiming all old data recovered
Cloud errors and timestamps are tracked independently for setup, download and upload
Raw and optional actual exercise loads convert together while immutable Coach snapshots retain their original units
Conflicting retained-legacy Health updates require review and do not overwrite an arbitrary record or consume their shared anchor

Earlier seven fixes integrated: backup revision conflicts, nutrition targets on resume, recovery suggestions, Undo Skip validation, reviewed removed-slot restoration, calendar heading parsing and civil-day scheduling

user_flow_ui.initial_failure_analysis: Recorded UI confirmed Save succeeded. Focus-driven scrolling moved the confirmation below the viewport while the test searched upward; the helper now searches downward and uses a semantic button tap. Assertions and product behavior are unchanged.
user_flow_ui.result: All three target workflows verified; the initial nutrition test-navigation failure is retained above.

targeted_simulator_tests.note: Six core tests, two workflows from the initial user-flow run, and the corrected nutrition rerun. These are selected tests, not the full UI suite.

limits: All runtime tests used disposable synthetic stores and isolated Simulator fixtures
No affected-user device/account or live production CloudKit sync was tested
This patch cannot recreate records that only existed in a deleted installation without a surviving cloud/device/export/backup copy
The additional conflicting Health-import batch guard belongs to the retained legacy importer; the current normal path uses Cardio Inbox

incident_findings.reported_flow: Updates 2.5 and a follow-up stayed on the history-attention screen; deleting and reinstalling opened the app but old history was missing.
incident_findings.observed_screen: Your history needs attention; local schema added an unrecognized table.
reproduced_upgrade_blockers: The migration guard rejected legitimate model additions.
Recovery journals used absolute paths that could become stale after an app-container relocation.
incident_findings.evidence_limit: Synthetic migration cases reproduce these blockers; the affected user device was not available to identify every cause in that installation.
incident_findings.reinstall_effect: Deleting the installation removes local-only history and migration state. Reinstallation cannot recover records that lack a surviving iCloud, device, export or backup copy.
incident_findings.affected_user_history: Not recovered or verified during this work.

follow_up_recovery_audit.assessment: The historical upgrade/retry and both reinstall branches are now explicitly checked offline, plus all 24 populated model types. Recovery is not fully cleared: duplicate-UUID backup restore fails, automatic repair has a remote-deletion race, profile units may be lost after reinstall, and affected-account Production cloud restoration is unverified.

historical_report_notice: This records the earlier investigation state. The three subsequently identified backup, remote-deletion repair, and profile-unit issues are addressed by the linked fix validation report; affected-account Production recovery remains unverified.
